Card Q&A.q: If I have a 2-color yellow/red Tamer, can I count it as 2 Tamers for this card's [Main] effect?

Card Q&A.a: 3 of your opponent's Digimon get -4000 DP. This card's effect only targets 3 of your opponent's Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If I have 2 yellow or red Tamers, does this card's [Main] effect give 6 of my opponent's Digimon -2000 DP for the turn or 3 of my opponent's Digimon -4000 DP for the turn?

Effect: [Main] You may play 1 [Marcus Damon] from your hand without paying the cost. Then, to 3 of your opponent's Digimon, give -2000 DP for the turn for each of your yellow or red Tamers.
